audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] called Edge of Ixtal her (W) dash — Edge of Ixtal is the empowered Q; the dash-to-element is Terrashape (W) and the dash-to-enemy is Audacity (E). audit.why: Kit: Q 7s flat, W Terrashape 7s 1100-range dash, E Audacity 11-7s 650 dash, R 120s flat with knockup/stun off terrain.

notes: Packet defect for the user: chart gives Qiyana 6/7 stages while Vladimir wins 53.97% — likely the mid rows over-credit her, but stage ownership is not kit-decidable so the full layer was aligned to the existing content chart, not re-adjudicated. All three suspectNames confirmed false positives (correct ability names inside sentences). Real name/slot defects fixed instead: 'Element Q' -> Elemental Wrath, and Edge of Ixtal was mislabeled as her W dash (it is the empowered Q; W is Terrashape, E is Audacity). Content 'early' still says 'elemental Q' generically — acceptable shorthand, left alone. Report edits beyond two are pronoun-only lint fixes.
